Extends the selected range through the complete four-section outer confirmation and original dating 60550–60552 plus editorial dating 60553, before new XXX at 60562. The chapter decree 60419–60458 and congregational decree 60466–60478, including their dating, signatures and seal line, are explicitly embedded instruments; the present papal confirmation is printed at 60501–60516. Preserves the displaced title-linked historical note 60398–60400 and correction 60449. Frozen sibling u0051 starts at stray isolated 60396, has no independent protocol, and covers continuation of this same XXIX; that catalogue dependency is recorded without changing the canonical unit.
